Bid 197 dashboard · UX map

The map used when revising the IBU Bid 197 dashboard: what each piece is, where it is made, what it responds to, and the order to change and test things in. The full text version is bid197/UX-MAP.md in the repo.

Provisional: the dashboard shows Bid 196 lines until the Bid 197 sheet is issued. cycle.js is the one switch; the data-swap steps are at the bottom.
Open the dashboardDesign revisions canvasBid 196 template

Build pipeline

src/* → patch.py (+extra.js, +extra.css, cycle.js) → build/* → build.py → dist/bid197.html → tests/sweep.js → publish to the same artifact URL

Script order inside the page: cycle.js → data.js → prev195.js → icons.js → sprite → lib.js → baymap.js → app.js. Never edit build/ or dist/; patch.py asserts every anchor so an upstream change fails loudly.

Revision playbook

AskTouch
wordingcycle.js
restyleextra.css
behaviourpatch.py anchor + extra.js
chartspatch.py lib section
datasrc/data.js is upstream; resync + re-record hash
publishArtifact file_path dist/bid197.html

When the Bid 197 sheet posts

  1. new src/data.js (197) + hash
  2. src/prev196.js with PREV + CHG
  3. cycle.js sheet 197 prevSheet 196 provisional false dates
  4. rewrite upstream hard-coded sheet facts
  5. rebuild, sweep, publish same URL

Design rules carried from Bid 196

  • Hue has two jobs only: route identity and status. Session is a text label.
  • Barlow body, Barlow Semi Condensed display and numbers, tabular digits on every time.
  • Nothing under 12 px; every tap target at least 44 px under 900 px.
  • Shadow only on the lead card, the hero and the bid hero. Few cards, no tiles inside cards inside cards.
  • Glance rows count exactly like the phone guide. Crew slots are what the data says; never invent names.
